name: Warryn Umpen Pallabar Oppleby Reddlepop Turen
subclass: Pact of the Tome (Patron: Loopholes & Spoken Intent)
equipment: Studded Leather Armor (12 + Dex mod AC = 13)
Half Price Potion (roll d100 for effect)
Favourite leathery book (Bond item / Book of Shadows)

spellcasting.name: Warlock Spellcasting (Charisma)
spellcasting.desc: Spell save DC 13; spell attack +5. Spell slots: 2 (2nd level) — all slots are 2nd level, regained on short or long rest. Cantrips: Argument, Chill Touch, Fire Bolt, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, True Strike. 1st-level spells known: Bane, Charm Person. 2nd-level spells known: Hold Person, Mirror Image, Misty Step.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6+1 piercing.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 1d4+1 piercing.

actions.name: Cast a Spell
actions.desc: Spell save DC 13; spell attack +5. 2 second-level slots. Spells: Bane, Charm Person, Hold Person, Mirror Image, Misty Step.

class_features.name: Otherworldly Patron — Loopholes, Bargains & Spoken Intent
class_features.desc: Patron deals in fine print and spoken word. If someone casts Detect Thoughts on Warryn, they will be frightened by what they encounter. The patron provides a Pact of the Tome.

class_features.name: Pact of the Tome
class_features.desc: Warryn possesses a Book of Shadows — his favourite leathery book. He may cast three additional cantrips from any class spell list at will while the book is on his person. If lost, a 1-hour ceremony (during short or long rest) summons a replacement. The book turns to ash when he dies.

class_features.name: Eldritch Invocation: Devil's Sight
class_features.desc: Warryn can see normally in darkness, both magical and nonmagical, to a distance of 120 feet.

class_features.name: Combat Ability: The Argument
class_features.desc: Once per combat, when Warryn speaks aloud as part of casting a spell or taking an action, he may append an Argument. Choose one creature within 30 ft that can hear him — Wisdom save vs DC 13. On a fail choose: Rebuttal Damage (2d6 psychic), Staggered Logic (disadvantage on next attack/save), or Forced Pause (speed becomes 0 until start of its next turn). On success: half damage or no effect. DOWNSIDE: Warryn becomes visibly marked by drifting margin-lines and glowing text. The first attack against him before his next turn has advantage.

class_features.name: Court Functionary (Background)
class_features.desc: Understands court bureaucracy. Can gain access to officials and information through court connections.

traits.name: Personality
traits.desc: Trait: Good at two-digit multiplication; terrified of liquorice. Ideal: Will always seek new spells. Bond: His favourite leathery book (Book of Shadows). Flaw: Believes he can sell ice-cream to an Eskimo — literally.

traits.name: Rock Gnome
traits.desc: Darkvision 60 ft. Gnome Cunning: advantage on Int/Wis/Cha saving throws against magic. Artificer's Lore: double proficiency on History checks about magic, tech, or alchemy. Tinker: construct tiny clockwork devices.

goals: Find Albus — the warlock who stole his wife — and destroy him
Reconnect with a woman to feel that lost connection again
Gather clues about Albus's whereabouts through the gnome expedition
Collect and learn new spells — always
backstory: Warryn has six children, but his wife cheated on him and left 20 years ago, taking the kids. She left him for a warlock named Albus. He became a warlock himself to beat Albus at his own game — to one day find him and destroy him. He joined the gnome expedition hoping it would lead him to clues about Albus, or his wife and children. His constant humour and flirtatious manner is a coping mechanism. The real Warryn — the grieving, vengeful one — only slips out rarely. Remember the fish scene? That was the mask slipping.
notes: Level 4 update: Now has 2nd level spell slots. New spells include Hold Person, Mirror Image, Misty Step. Has Devil's Sight invocation — sees in magical and nonmagical darkness 120ft. New weapons: Shortsword and Daggers. AC is 13 (Studded Leather + Dex). Has 154gp, 5sp. His patron is drawn to him because of the legal and emotional loopholes in his grief. Nobody in the party knows his true motivation.
